about.commitmentContent:
Turi izo zifuatazo kuelekea jamii ya Bitcoin: 
 • Daima kuwa chanzo wazi 
 • Kutoa maudhui ya elimu ya hali ya juu 
 • Kutafsiri maudhui yetu katika lugha nyingi iwezekanavyo 
 • Kuunga mkono wajasiriamali wa Bitcoin katika safari yao
about.coreTeamContent: Plan ₿ Network ni ihuriro rigizwe n’isinzi ry’abantu batanga intererano, abigisha, imboneza z'imirwi y'ikibano, abacafyi bokubuhinga bwa none, abateza imbere ubuhinga bwa none, hamwe n'abahuza bikorwa. Turashimira ivyumwihariko abantu benshi batumye Plan ₿ ibaho kandi babandanya kubikora uko bukeye n’uko bwije.(Urutonde rw’abatanze intererano ruzoshirwa ahabona vuba)
about.corporateContent: Plan ₿ Network ni ihwaniro ry'imigambi ugizwe n'amashirahamwe atatu yibanda kw'iterambere rya Bitcoin. Mu ntumbero yo kwagura inyigisho zijanye na Bitcoin no kuzishikana kure hashoboka, ayo mashirahamwe yaciye afata ingingo yo gukorana, maze hashingwa Plan ₿ Network. Kuva icogihe, ayandi mashirahamwe menshi yahisemwo guterera hamwe nogushira inguvu hamwe kugira ngo adufashe gushikana inyigisho za Bitcoin kw’isi yose. Kubera iyo mvo, tubashimiye bivuye ku mutima.

bCert.bCertDescription: ₿-CERT ni ikibazo ca nyuma cikwije ca Bitcoin kigenewe gusuzuma ubumenyi bwawe ku bijanye na Bitcoin hamwe n’ibijanye nicocigwa. Iyo ushikanye hejuru ya 80%, uzoronka impamyabushobozi ya ₿-CERT yerekana ubuhinga bwawe mu bijanye n'uruganda rwa Bitcoin, kikazoshobora kwugurura amarembo y’akazi atandukanye mu buhinga bwa Bitcoin.
